title: Eigenzeit v0.2: validity map and information requirements
experiment: Deterministic numerical evaluation of exact finite-binomial expressions; no new point-cloud draws or empirical efficacy trial

models.uniform_flat: All listed dimensions; fixed central endpoints, complete inclusion and iid uniform observed background points
models.de_sitter: d=4, metric (1-h*t)^-2 eta on |t|+norm(x)<1/2. Theta is true inner/outer geodesic proper time; inner coordinate span a=2*tanh(theta*atanh(h/2))/h. Known physical outer scale. Exact volume ratio, no RSS truncation
models.density: Flat d=4 with sampling intensity proportional to 1+beta*(2t)^2; theta=a
models.thinning_scope: Flat d=4; independent retention by membership in the fixed inner interval; m counts retained points, not acquisition attempts
models.density_twins: For each de Sitter cell, flat metric with intensity proportional to (1-h*t)^-4, identical coordinates/order law, but true theta=a

intervals.scope: Nominal for every model; bounded intervals additionally for all flat d=4 models. Bounds constrain the mean observed sampling intensity inside versus outside the inner interval, r. They are supplied externally, not diagnosed from counts. They do not correct curved geometry

precision_definition: For transformed interval [L,U], use harmonic center H=2LU/(L+U), relative radius (U-L)/(U+L). Precision if radius <=0.1. False precision if precision AND abs(H/theta-1)>0.1. Raw estimator remains (K/m)^(1/d) and is reported separately
gate: MEETS_DECLARED_GRID_CRITERIA only if model assumptions hold, coverage>=0.95 within numerical tolerance, and precision probability>=0.90. Otherwise OUTSIDE_ASSUMED_CLASS or INSUFFICIENT_GRID_PRECISION. This is cell-specific and not empirical certification of assumptions
planning: Report every evaluated m and the smallest passing count on the declared grid. Do not call it a global minimum or presume monotonicity. Always report cells with no passing grid count

numerics.scope: Float64 numerical evaluations, with explicit omitted-binomial-tail bounds. Neither quadrature convergence nor library agreement is a formal rounding-error certificate. Retain support and exact integer acceptance bounds

freeze: Publish contract, derivation, runner and independent checks before first target-grid evaluation. Selftests use separate off-grid controls. This is a project source freeze, not independent preregistration
nonclaims: No simultaneous or anytime coverage claim for displayed intervals
No resolution of unrestricted density twins
No applicability to dependent data or postselected endpoints
No changes to earlier frozen studies
